title: Quickstart new Libre sensor with NFC reading and blucon
symptom: After installing the latest nightly (190519), starting a new Libre sensor with NFC scan no longer works; only Blucon readings are accepted.
cause: A sanity check was added for Blucon that may be rejecting values due to sensor serial number changes.
fix: The issue may be fixed in the next release; in the meantime, downgrade.
evidence_quote: we justr add sanity check for Blucon, might be that this is fixed in next release.
